rationale: This is a cosmetic aggregation swap on the archive's best signal that collapses to a plain rank-average of two long-published anomalies (Novy-Marx gross profitability deflated by Hirshleifer-style net operating assets, plus Sloan accruals), so it has diagnostic value at best and essentially no standalone novelty.

The proposal states a positive expected sign while the reasoning openly predicts a materially weaker or negligible spread, which is an internally inconsistent submission of a deliberately-worse variant of an archived signal rather than a candidate expected to improve the joint evidence.

A substantive extension of the conjunctive structure with an economically distinct third screen, though the added cash-realization leg had a wrong-signed Fama-MacBeth slope in the archive and a triple MIN risks concentrating the long leg into a small, unstable, cash-rich subset — so the comparison against the two-hurdle version must be interpreted with coverage in hand.

Substituting the accrual-stock realization channel for the accrual-flow channel inside the winning conjunction is a legitimate generalization test rather than a rediscovery, but it overlaps heavily with the triple-hurdle proposal and inherits the che/act channel's cross-sectional sign divergence, so its incremental information is moderate.

A clean, well-motivated ablation that isolates whether the NOA deflator or the conjunctive screening drives the archive's best result, though the resulting construct — profitability screened by accruals — is itself close to a well-known joint screen and is unlikely to be a novel signal in its own right.

The frequency-of-cash-backed-years count is a genuinely new, magnitude-invariant accrual construct that is not a variant of the archive's level or moving-average accrual conditioners, though the multiplicative industry z-score can turn negative and flip the profitability rank's sign — the same structure that produced perverse results in several archived conditional signals, so the sign behavior in the low-consistency tail should be checked.
